ticket.subject: Password reset email never arrives
ticket.body_text:
Hey team,

I look after our account at Hollowfen Media. The password reset link is not coming through to my inbox, and I have checked the spam folder.

I can still use the mobile app because I am signed in there, so I am not completely stuck. Colleagues on the same email domain receive your emails fine.

Could you look into this sometime this week? Please send a reset link or reset it from your side.

Thanks so much!
Fatima
